ai_analysis.trigger: Finding a kid whose uncle had been killed by monsters
ai_analysis.lore_summary: While exploring the dark tunnels in Metro, Jonesy encountered a young boy named Sasha next to his dead uncle. The boy asked for help to escape the monsters.
ai_analysis.notable_quote: You don't look as strong as Uncle...

ai_analysis.trigger: A dead monster's eyeball popped out
ai_analysis.lore_summary: While navigating a dark train car, Jonesy found a dead monster. Suddenly, its eyeball popped out, causing her to exclaim in disgust.

ai_analysis.reaction: Screamed in terror as she was shot at
ai_analysis.trigger: An enemy Panzer suddenly appeared on the tracks
ai_analysis.lore_summary: While walking down a train tunnel, Jonesy was suddenly confronted by a heavily armed Panzer that opened fire, causing her to scream in panic.
ai_analysis.notable_quote: Oh my God! It's a Panzer!
ai_analysis.clip_outcome: Under heavy fire from a Panzer

ai_analysis.reaction: Frustrated but unsurprised by her failure
ai_analysis.trigger: Crashing a plane while trying to escape
ai_analysis.lore_summary: While attempting to fly a plane with an enemy on the wing, Jonesy accidentally crashed it into the ground, failing the mission and admitting she is terrible with planes.
ai_analysis.notable_quote: I flippin' knew that was gonna happen!
ai_analysis.clip_outcome: Mission failed due to crashing the plane

ai_analysis.reaction: Laughed at the absurdity of her actions
ai_analysis.trigger: Running over a pedestrian while rushing to save her in-game wife
ai_analysis.lore_summary: In a desperate rush to save Amanda, Jonesy ran over an innocent man, hilariously justifying the vehicular assault by stating how important her wife is.
ai_analysis.notable_quote: See, this is how important my wife is to me!

ai_analysis.trigger: Deciding she needed a police car
ai_analysis.lore_summary: Needing to escape the cops, Jonesy ironically decided the best course of action was to drag a police officer out of his cruiser and steal it.

ai_analysis.trigger: Stealing a white sports car and backing over the owner
ai_analysis.lore_summary: Spotting a nice white sports car, Jonesy stole it and immediately backed over the owner, offering a very casual apology as she sped away.
ai_analysis.notable_quote: Sorry, had to take your car and then kill you, oopsie!
ai_analysis.clip_outcome: Stole a car and ran over its owner

ai_analysis.trigger: Using the fill tool in MS Paint
ai_analysis.lore_summary: While drawing a magnificent MS Paint rendition of the Balrog from Lord of the Rings, Jonesy confidently asserted there were no gaps before using the fill tool.
ai_analysis.notable_quote: I don't see that there's any holes there.

ai_analysis.reaction: Questioning if shooting a sleeping man counts as stealth
ai_analysis.lore_summary: Unsure how to execute a melee stealth kill, Jonesy opted to simply shoot a sleeping enemy point-blank, dubbing it 'kind of stealth'.

ai_analysis.trigger: Jumping off a balcony onto a stone path
ai_analysis.lore_summary: Instead of taking the stairs, Jonesy confidently vaulted Michael off a second-story balcony, declaring 'Bye ankles!' as he faceplanted onto the stone path.
ai_analysis.clip_outcome: Michael suffered significant fall damage but survived
